lanes.name: Merged Public
lanes.summary: 10,000 minted sealed to the treasury 2026-08-19 with the immutable provenance hash committed at deploy; the reveal follows the MP-REVEAL.md runbook, phase by phase, gate by gate.

phases.name: Assignment engine + public verifier
phases.gate: Engine runs are bit-for-bit repeatable across machines and the public verifier passes the generated set clean.
phases.note: Gate A passed 2026-08-19: fresh-process engine runs byte-identical and independently reproduced; the public verifier (generator/merged-public/verify-mp.mjs) passes the set clean and survived mutation testing. The engine stays private until reveal by design (MP-REVEAL.md).

phases.name: Season Zero commitment
phases.gate: Gated on Phase A plus an operator signature for the on-chain echo — no Archive Game clue may be published before this lands.
phases.note: Package generated and hash-verified three ways 2026-08-19 (the manifest and its commitment hash are staged locally); what remains is the operator's: back up the assignment and salt offline, publish the manifest, sign the treasury echo.

phases.name: Art production
phases.gate: Every trait key in weights.json resolves to exactly one asset file (plus the hat-fit variants) and a random 100-entity contact sheet passes visual review.

phases.name: Composite + metadata
phases.gate: Exactly 10,000 metadata files, every JSON parses, the public verifier passes the set, and 50 random tokens plus all 10 legendaries spot-render clean.

phases.name: Pin at directory scale
phases.gate: Locally computed directory CIDs match the returned CIDs, a redundant second pin exists, and at least 20 random tokens byte-verify through two public gateways.
phases.note: Tooling ready and adversarially verified 2026-08-19 (scripts/pin-mp-reveal.mjs — local CID first, hard assert against the pin service). The 10,000-file parity test was attempted and refused by the pin service's free-tier file cap — a paid pinning plan is now a confirmed hard prerequisite for reveal week (MP-REVEAL.md Phase E).

phases.name: Reveal day
phases.gate: Commitment opened publicly, reveal(baseURI) signed by the operator, tokenURI readback exact-matches, marketplace refresh swept.

phases.name: Soak + freeze
phases.gate: A 7-14 day soak with marketplaces rendering correctly and no metadata bug reports outstanding, then the irreversible freezeURI().

lanes.name: The Archive Game
lanes.summary: The rulebook is public in MP-GAME.md; Season Zero opens only when its manifest hash is published in this repo and echoed on chain 4663, which has not happened yet.
